review.assessment: This change introduces a baseline implementation of `word_frequencies` that splits text solely on spaces, preserves original casing, and returns an unsorted vector derived from HashMap iteration. It establishes a starting point that completely ignores the task's explicit requirements for case-insensitivity, splitting on non-alphanumeric delimiters, and deterministic sorting by count then alphabetically. Consequently, while the provided test passes trivially, any input violating these constraints will produce incorrect or unordered results.

findings.defect: Fails to split on non-alphanumeric characters, leaving punctuation attached to words and missing separate counts for distinct tokens.
Fails to treat words case-insensitively, treating differently cased versions of the same word as distinct entries.
Fails to sort results by count descending with alphabetical tie-breaking, relying on arbitrary HashMap iteration order.
